gap_analysis.ci_drift_gate_with_exit_codes: none of the found tools expose plan/diff vs live as a machine-readable CI gate
gap_analysis.byte_exact_xml_roundtrip_proof: none verify export/import byte fidelity with hashes; this is precisely JARVIS's recorded S3 defect class (V7_S2 F1: CRLF translation + UTF-16 self-declaration mismatch)
gap_analysis.agent_safe_scope_isolation: only CronTUI restricts to its own folder, and it is interactive-first with no plan gate; none implement refusal semantics + BLOCKED statuses for autonomous callers
gap_analysis.zero_dependency: ScheduledTaskManagement requires module install; jmgrenier requires pywin32; none are stdlib-only Python

domains.owner_evidence_strength: STRONG: installer.py ~400 lines hand-rolled schtasks parsing; S3 XML-byte incident; recurring lane blockers tagged BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_SHARED_WINDOWS_SCHEDULER; test-residue cleanup helper exists in-tree
domains.reason: Real documented pain, demonstrable functional gaps in all found alternatives, crisp bounded MVP, fully offline-testable, direct strategic fit with owner's Windows autonomy stack.
